text: Figure 9.81: Interfaces for recovery Name: RecoveryAction Technology: Port interface Generated: No Meta-model interface type: PhmRecoveryActionInterface Usage: Public API Description: This interface provides functions to control triggering of recovery actions, to determine the status of the supervision and a callback to perform recovery . Offer Enables potential invocations of the callback Recovery Handler(). RecoveryHandler Callback to be invoked by Platform Health Management upon a supervision failure. The handler invocation needs to be enabled before using Offer(). Operations: StopOffer Disables potential invocations of the callback Recovery Handler().
